notes: Fault scan: thousands more BMW fault codes now show their meaning, including newer models such as the G80 (for example the exhaust flap faults) and front camera faults on newer cars. A long piece of text pasted into the gateway address box no longer stops the scan. Lists in the small windows (Code several, Fault scan, TAL exclude, FSC, reports, signed NCD) sort by a column when you click its title. Code several changes finishes as soon as its report is read, and an error before a module was coded is no longer shown as a coding error for that module. Full backup leaves E-Sys's SVT tidy afterwards, and CAFD lines in the SVT tree are easy to read when selected. NCD compare: All settings matches another CAFD only by names E-Sys MAX is sure of, and says when there is no sure match. Ignition on / off: a clear message when the car's body module does not take the command. Free trial and blocked PCs: E-Sys MAX now shows the real reason and what to do.
